title: Single Choice
instructions: Every question in this quiz is of one type: Single Choice.
Use it to test how this question type looks and is marked.

questions.question: Which of these quantities is a **vector**?
questions.explanation: Displacement has magnitude and direction. The others have magnitude only.

questions.question: What is the chemical symbol for sodium?
questions.explanation: Na comes from the Latin name natrium.

questions.question: Which data structure works on a first-in, first-out basis?
questions.explanation: A queue removes items in the order they were added.
